title: Dragons Speak
description:
By default SkyrimNet only lets an NPC speak if its race allows player dialogue, which rules out every dragon. This plugin adds every dragon race in the load order to the actor filter's whitelist, so dragons can hold a conversation like any other NPC.

There is one file per mod that adds a dragon race (the vanilla and DLC dragons, Unslaad, Midwood Isle, Ultimate Dragons, Path of Sorcery, Triumvirate and Alternate Perspective), so you can switch off one mod's dragons on the Filters page without touching the rest. If you use whitelist-only filtering, this also makes dragons eligible speakers.
